Dialogues.String: Welcome to the Arcane Library, traveler. What brings you to this place of knowledge?
I seek knowledge of the ancient arcane arts.
The knowledge you seek is not easily found, but I may be able to guide you. Choose your path wisely.
Tell me about the ancient scrolls of the mystics.
The mystics, long forgotten by many, preserved their knowledge in sacred scrolls hidden across the lands.
These scrolls are said to contain spells that could alter the very fabric of reality.
What do you know of the forbidden tomes?
The forbidden tomes were locked away for a reason. Many who sought their power were consumed by the very magic they hoped to wield.
Only a few brave souls dare to even speak of their existence, let alone seek them out.
That is all I can share for now, traveler. Be careful as you tread these dangerous paths.
Thank you for your wisdom. I will return when I am ready to continue my journey.
